nate_csm: Heads up — Aurelia Health pilot went quiet after week 2. Metrics show a ~72% drop in API calls vs week 1. Putting a renewal red flag on this. Anyone seen onboarding or infra issues?

amanda_cs: Noticed the drop yesterday. Champion (Leah) responded once then went dark. PM mentioned they paused embeds testing last week.

raj_engine: Any 5xx or infra errors? I can scan logs if you paste a sample window.

nate_csm: Quick numbers from our console: 
```
week1.api.requests = 1180
week2.api.requests = 330
avg_tokens/session = 540 -> 120
error.rate = 0.1% (no spike)
```
No obvious 5xx spikes. Looks behavioral.

raj_engine: Good to know. I'll grep for any client-side anomalies. Also: did they upgrade our SDK? We've seen client caching dropping apparent usage in a past case.

sarah_seat_ops: I ran the kickoff notes — Leah said they'd toggle embeds to reduce cost; PM was testing alternatives. I'll DM Leah now.

amanda_cs: Another datapoint: procurement hinted they sat through a VeloxAI demo yesterday. Could be a competitive move. Recommend we surface cost vs quality and offer a low-friction trial extension.

jordan_sales: I can do an exec touch if we want to push a short dedicated trial. Need a 1-paragraph brief and proposed trial terms. @legal_ops can you fast-review?

ops-bot: Automated alert: renewal_risk_score increased to 0.78 for account=AureliaHealth.

legal_ops: Can review. If we do a trial extension we need an addendum — send proposed duration and scope (data retention, support level).

raj_engine: Quick infra check done — no system regressions, no routing failures. Client-side SDK version mismatch is the leading hypothesis. Ask them for SDK version + console errors and a HAR/sampled request.

amanda_cs: I'll send this template to Leah now (short ask + 30m troubleshooting slot). Template includes request for `SDK version`, `sample request id`, and `console logs` and offers a 2-week dedicated trial or a cost optimization pass.

nate_csm: Plan: 1) re-engage Leah + PM today; 2) offer 2-week dedicated trial + cost analysis; 3) collect SDK/version + sample logs; 4) if no response in 48h escalate to procurement with competitive notes. Owners: amanda_cs (re-engage + telemetry ask), jordan_sales (exec escalation), raj_engine (tech triage), legal_ops (trial addendum). Agree?

jordan_sales: Agree, I'll prep the exec note and standby for outreach once amanda confirms engagement.

amanda_cs: DM sent to Leah. Leaving the 30m slot open this afternoon. Will post outcome here. :thumbsup:

nate_csm: Thanks — track updates here. If we hear nothing by EOD+2, we'll trigger procurement ping and sales outreach.

ops-bot: Note: created playbook task #CS-1427 for "post-pilot silent — renewal triage" and assigned to amanda_cs.
